# Hot Rod's Downtown Barber Shop

> Old-school barbershop based in Bloomington, Indiana. Old-school cuts, clean fades and straight-razor shaves from master barber Rod Pheifer and crew, in a red-and-white shop full of hubcaps and IU history on North Walnut. Get what you want.

- Phone: (812) 336-0092
- Based in: Bloomington, IN
- Nearby areas: Bloomington, Ellettsville, Bedford, Martinsville, Spencer, Nashville
- Google rating: 4.9 from 183 reviews
- Book an appointment: https://ronaks-code.github.io/sitelift-demos/barbershops/indiana/hot-rods-downtown-barber-shop/quote.html
- Pick a time: https://ronaks-code.github.io/sitelift-demos/barbershops/indiana/hot-rods-downtown-barber-shop/book.html

## Services
- Haircuts: Classic cuts done the old-school way. Tell your barber what you want and he takes the time to get it right.
- Fades: Clean, sharp fades at a fair price. A regular favorite with IU students and downtown regulars alike.
- Kids' cuts: Little ones climb up into the red chairs and leave grinning. The barbers are patient, even with two-year-olds.
- Curly hair: Curls cut evenly and shaped to sit right, with a fade or taper underneath if you want one.
- Beard trims: Shape-ups and full-beard trims to go with your cut, or on their own.
- Straight-razor shaves: The old-school shave, done with a straight razor in a vintage barber chair.

## About
There has been a barbershop at 220 N Walnut St for a long time. Grigsby & McAdams cut hair here for about 25 years, then Hyscel Ward took over in 1980 and ran it as Ward's Downtown Barber Shop. In July 2014 master barber Rodney "Hot Rod" Pheifer, who already ran Hot Rod's Barber Shop in Monrovia, stopped in and bought the place two days later. He renamed it Hot Rod's Downtown Barbershop and kept everything that made it special. Inside it's red chairs, white porcelain sinks and walls covered in hubcaps, old Indiana license plates, straight razors and IU basketball history. Part barbershop, part hot rod museum. The barbers are friendly, take their time and make sure the cut is right before you get up. IU students, downtown regulars and families with kids all end up in the same row of chairs.

## Frequently asked questions
- Q: Where are you?
  A: 220 N Walnut St, Bloomington, IN 47404, downtown on North Walnut. Look for the barber pole and the red HOT ROD'S lettering in the window.
- Q: What are your hours?
  A: Monday 8:30 AM to 6:30 PM, Tuesday to Friday 8:30 AM to 7 PM and Saturday 9 AM to 3 PM. Closed Sunday. Hours can change on holidays, so call ahead.
- Q: Do you take walk-ins?
  A: Yes, walk-ins are welcome. Busy days fill up, so if you want a set time, call (812) 336-0092 and we'll fit you in.
- Q: Who owns Hot Rod's?
  A: Master barber Rodney "Hot Rod" Pheifer. He bought the shop in 2014 and also runs the original Hot Rod's Barber Shop in Monrovia.
- Q: Do you cut kids' hair?
  A: Yes. Kids' cuts are a regular thing here, and the barbers are patient with the little ones.
- Q: Do you do shaves and beard trims?
  A: Yes. Beard trims and straight-razor shaves, on their own or with a haircut.
- Q: I'm an IU student. Is this a good spot?
  A: Students have been coming here for years for a great cut at a fair price, and it's a short walk from campus.
